## 1. Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(ggplot2)
library(tmap)
library(patchwork)
library(classInt)
library(scales)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

source("R_codes/mapping_data.R")

dfw_4326 <- st_transform(dfw_map, 4326)
dfw_5070 <- st_transform(dfw_map, 5070)
dfw_3857 <- st_transform(dfw_map, 3857)
```

## 2. Join and Check

```{r}
#| label: join-check

print(missing_boundaries)

nrow(dfw_map)

st_geometry_type(dfw_map)

dfw_5070 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    county,
    adoption_rate,
    electric_vehicles,
    charging_stations,
    charging_ports,
    median_household_income
  )
```

## 3. Comparing Map Projections

```{r}
#| label: projection-comparison
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5

map_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "grey35"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 12, b = 10, l = 8)
  )

p_4326 <- ggplot(dfw_4326) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = adoption_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "EPSG:4326 (WGS84)",
    subtitle = "Geographic lat/lon"
  ) +
  map_theme

p_3857 <- ggplot(dfw_3857) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = adoption_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator)",
    subtitle = "Pseudo-Mercator"
  ) +
  map_theme

p_5070 <- ggplot(dfw_5070) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = adoption_rate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Adoption Rate",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = grid::unit(9, "cm"),
      barheight = grid::unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "EPSG:5070 (Conus Albers)",
    subtitle = "Equal-area projection"
  ) +
  map_theme

p_4326 + p_3857 + p_5070 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


## 4. EV Adoption Choropleth

```{r}
#| label: adoption-choropleth

ggplot(dfw_5070) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = adoption_rate), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "mako",
    direction = -1,
    name = "EV Adoption Rate\n(% of Vehicles)",
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Electric Vehicle Adoption Rate Across 16 DFW Counties",
    subtitle = "Share of registered vehicles that are electric (EPSG:5070, Conus Albers)",
    caption = "Sources: EV Registration Report (Jan 1, 2026); US Census Bureau / tigris (2025)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```


## 4.2. Comparing Classification Methods

```{r}
#| label: classification-comparison
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 7

vals <- dfw_5070$adoption_rate

format_pct_breaks <- function(brks) {
  paste0(
    scales::percent(head(brks, -1), accuracy = 0.1),
    " – ",
    scales::percent(tail(brks, -1), accuracy = 0.1)
  )
}

brks_equal <- classIntervals(vals, n = 4, style = "equal")$brks
brks_quantile <- classIntervals(vals, n = 4, style = "quantile")$brks
brks_jenks <- classIntervals(vals, n = 4, style = "jenks")$brks

dfw_class <- dfw_5070 |>
  mutate(
    cls_equal = cut(
      adoption_rate,
      breaks = brks_equal,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = format_pct_breaks(brks_equal)
    ),
    cls_quantile = cut(
      adoption_rate,
      breaks = brks_quantile,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = format_pct_breaks(brks_quantile)
    ),
    cls_jenks = cut(
      adoption_rate,
      breaks = brks_jenks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = format_pct_breaks(brks_jenks)
    )
  )

make_cls_map <- function(data, col_sym, title_txt) {

  ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(
      aes(fill = {{ col_sym }}),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(
      option = "viridis",
      name = "EV Adoption Rate",
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    labs(title = title_txt) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 7,
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "grey90",
        linewidth = 0.25
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.1, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 10)
    )
}

m_equal <- make_cls_map(
  dfw_class,
  cls_equal,
  "Equal Interval"
)

m_quantile <- make_cls_map(
  dfw_class,
  cls_quantile,
  "Quantile"
)

m_jenks <- make_cls_map(
  dfw_class,
  cls_jenks,
  "Jenks Natural Breaks"
)

m_equal + m_quantile + m_jenks +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3)
```


## 5. Proportional-Symbol Map

```{r}
#| label: proportional-symbol-map

dfw_centroids <- dfw_5070 |>
  mutate(centroid = st_centroid(geometry))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = dfw_5070,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = dfw_centroids,
    aes(geometry = centroid, size = charging_stations),
    color = "#0F766E",
    fill = "#14B8A6",
    alpha = 0.65,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    name = "Charging Stations",
    max_size = 14,
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Public EV Charging Stations Across DFW Counties",
    subtitle = "Symbol area scaled to number of charging stations (EPSG:5070)",
    caption = "Sources: AFDC Historical Fuel Stations (Jan 1, 2026); US Census Bureau / tigris (2025)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
